name: SVR Poker Android
updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 349 adds unique player presence, one active presence row per player per room, seat leases, heartbeat expiry, reconnect recovery, and duplicate remote-player suppression.
Current unconfigured deployments use a clearly labeled same-browser BroadcastChannel/localStorage simulation and are not represented as internet multiplayer.
Authenticated production presence is prepared as a separate Phase 349 Node and Azure SQL service using the Phase 345 player session cookie.
Sitting claims canonical seat zero and leaving releases it; seat conflicts are surfaced rather than creating duplicate owners.
Remote players render as lightweight presence proxies within Android, Quest, and desktop budgets.
Poker cards, balances, turns, and pots remain local Phase 336 state; Phase 349 does not claim server-authoritative poker gameplay.
Camera 3 remains free of player account, avatar, and multiplayer presence modules.
Phase 347 Android controls and Phase 348 local avatar remain preserved.
No native Android wrapper source, signing identity, or installable APK is currently present in the repository.
Forced updates and recurring update prompts remain disabled.
